title: Zesty Pillowy Algerian Beans Casserole
description: A savory, fluffy casserole of refried garbanzo beans, feta, mozzarella, and sweet potato fritters, baked on a salt block for a salty finish.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat and sauté garlic and diced onion until translucent.
Add cumin, smoked paprika, and cayenne pepper to the pan and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the refried garbanzo beans, season with salt and pepper, and heat through.
Deep fry the sweet potato sticks in a separate pan or fryer at 375°F until golden and crisp, then drain on paper towels.
Carefully transfer the bean mixture onto the hot salt block, spreading it evenly.
Top the bean layer with crumbled feta, shredded mozzarella, halved cherry tomatoes, and sliced black olives.
Bake the casserole in a preheated oven at 375°F for 15 minutes, or until the cheeses melt and edges brown lightly.
Remove from the oven, let it rest on the salt block for 5 minutes to absorb flavor, then slice into portions.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
